new.title: How OsStr::new works
new.description: Views a &str as an &OsStr, without copying.

slides.caption: Every valid str is also a valid OsStr.

to_str.title: How OsStr::to_str works
to_str.description: The OsStr as &str, if it is valid Unicode.

slides.caption: File names on Unix can contain bytes that are not UTF-8.

to_string_lossy.title: How OsStr::to_string_lossy works
to_string_lossy.description: The OsStr as text, with invalid parts replaced by �.

slides.caption: Borrowed when no replacement was needed.
The usual way to print an OsStr.

to_os_string.title: How OsStr::to_os_string works
to_os_string.description: An owned OsString copy of a borrowed OsStr.

slides.caption: Needed to store it in a struct.

len.title: How OsStr::len works
len.description: The length in the platform encoding's bytes.

slides.caption: é takes two bytes in UTF-8 based encodings.

is_ascii.title: How OsStr::is_ascii works
is_ascii.description: true if every byte is ASCII.

eq_ignore_ascii_case.title: How OsStr::eq_ignore_ascii_case works
eq_ignore_ascii_case.description: Compares two OsStrs ignoring ASCII case.

to_ascii_lowercase.title: How OsStr::to_ascii_lowercase works
to_ascii_lowercase.description: A copy with ASCII letters made small.

to_ascii_uppercase.title: How OsStr::to_ascii_uppercase works
to_ascii_uppercase.description: A copy with ASCII letters made capital.

slides.caption: Works through &mut OsStr (e.g. on an OsString).
The bytes are changed where they are.

as_encoded_bytes.title: How OsStr::as_encoded_bytes works
as_encoded_bytes.description: The raw bytes of the OsStr in Rust's internal encoding.

slides.caption: ASCII and UTF-8 text come out as their normal bytes on every platform.
Useful for splitting at ASCII characters like "=".

into_os_string.title: How OsStr::into_os_string works
into_os_string.description: Turns a Box<OsStr> into an OsString without copying.

slides.caption: Build file names or arguments piece by piece.

push.title: How OsString::push works
push.description: Appends more text to the OsString.

slides.caption: PathBuf::push would add a path separator.

into_string.title: How OsString::into_string works
into_string.description: Converts to a String if valid Unicode; otherwise gives the OsString back.

with_capacity.title: How OsString::with_capacity works
with_capacity.description: An empty OsString with room reserved.

capacity.title: How OsString::capacity works
capacity.description: How much fits before the OsString must grow.

clear.title: How OsString::clear works
clear.description: Empties the OsString, keeping its capacity.

into_boxed_os_str.title: How OsString::into_boxed_os_str works
into_boxed_os_str.description: Turns the OsString into a Box<OsStr>, dropping spare capacity.

slides.caption: Saves memory for strings that never change.

into_encoded_bytes.title: How OsString::into_encoded_bytes works
into_encoded_bytes.description: Turns the OsString into its raw bytes (internal encoding).

slides.caption: ASCII and UTF-8 come out unchanged.
Turning bytes back needs unsafe from_encoded_bytes_unchecked.

leak.title: How OsString::leak works
leak.description: Gives up the OsString forever and returns a &'static mut OsStr.

slides.caption: For values that must live for the whole program.

reserve.title: How OsString::reserve works
reserve.description: Makes room for at least n more bytes.

reserve_exact.title: How OsString::reserve_exact works
reserve_exact.description: Makes room for exactly n more bytes.

try_reserve.title: How OsString::try_reserve works
try_reserve.description: Reserves room, returning an error instead of aborting.

from.title: How OsString::from works
from.description: An owned platform string from a String or &str.

slides.caption: Every Rust string is valid as an OsString.
Each piece is pushed onto the end.

from_iter.title: How OsString::from_iter works
from_iter.description: Joins an iterator of platform strings into one OsString.

slides.caption: Use PathBuf for path components instead.

from_encoded_bytes_unchecked.title: How OsStr::from_encoded_bytes_unchecked works
from_encoded_bytes_unchecked.description: An OsStr from bytes previously taken with as_encoded_bytes (unsafe).

slides.caption: Bytes must come from as_encoded_bytes, possibly split at ASCII.
Useful for splitting OS strings by ASCII.

osstring-from_encoded_bytes_unchecked.title: How OsString::from_encoded_bytes_unchecked works
osstring-from_encoded_bytes_unchecked.description: An OsString from bytes taken with into_encoded_bytes (unsafe).

slides.caption: Bytes must be a valid encoding for this platform.
